operations.why: Protocol 2168 writes a positional unsigned outer entry variant before the legacy uint8 action carried by each Add/Remove payload. The Endstone dump incorrectly reuses the legacy action enum as the outer selector and thereby reverses Add/Remove while dropping one wire byte.

evidence.summary: The pinned serializer writes varuint32 variant 0 for Remove and 1 for Add, then writes the legacy uint8 action before UUID and payload fields. Exact protocol-2168 fixtures reproduce this two-selector layout.
